meta.title: Bulk upload vendors from the Excel template
gaps: Navigate to the Vendors tab and use Bulk Upload/New Upload
Download and fill the Sample Template with the specified vendor details
Upload the completed Excel sheet and press OK
Assert that each uploaded vendor appears as a row in the Prospects tab
